title: Alphabet Blocks
description: A mod that adds 78 alphabet blocks (A to Z) in 3 colors: black, yellow and green. Two brushes allow you to paint black blocks into yellow or green by right clicking on them. A special tool called Destroy Letter can instantly remove any letter block.
body:
**Alphabet Block Mod**
A mod that adds alphabet blocks (A to Z) in 3 colors.

**Blocks**

78 letter blocks in total (26 letters × 3 colors)
- Black color — base version
- Yellow color — yellow painted version
- Green color — green painted version
- To break the blocks, you need an iron pickaxe or a better one.

**Tools**

- Yellow Brush — right click on a black letter block → transforms it into yellow
- Green Brush — right click on a black letter block → transforms it into green
- Black Brush — right click on a yellow or green letter block → transforms it into black

**Items**

- Yellow Feather - In ingredient tab
- Green Feather - In ingredient tab
- Black Feather - In ingredient tab

**Craft**

Items :
- To craft a Yellow feather you need a feather and a yellow dye
- To craft a Green feather you need a feather and a green dye
- To craft a Black feather you need a feather and a black dye

Tools:
- To craft a Yellow Brush you need a yellow feather and two stick
- To craft a Green Brush you need a green feather and two stick
- To craft a Black Brush you need a black feather and two stick

Blocks:
- To craft a Black letter block you need a stonecutter and in the stonecutter put a black concrete.
- To craft a Yellow letter block you can't you can just transform your black block into a Yellow and break it with you pickaxe to get one
- To craft a Green letter block you can't you can just transform your black block into a Green and break it with you pickaxe to get one
